network_status.network: Report di evento - eventi pluviometrici e idrometrici di ottobre 2018
network_status.summary_it: Il report ARPAS analizza la rete idrometrica interessata dall'evento del 10 ottobre, ma non pubblica una misura sul Rio Coccodi attribuibile all'attraversamento di Uta. Il vicino Gutturu Mannu appartiene a un diverso ramo del bacino e non viene sostituito al corso d'acqua del record.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPAS report reviews the gauge network affected by the 10 October event but publishes no Rio Coccodi measurement attributable to the Uta crossing. The nearby Gutturu Mannu is a different basin branch and is not substituted for the recorded watercourse.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
